actions.description: Check raw HTTP completion on v2 and public ports
actions.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import socket
for port in (8082, 8080):
    print('port', port)
    s=socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),2)
    s.settimeout(3)
    s.sendall(b'GET /health HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: localhost\r\n\r\n')
    chunks=[]
    try:
        while True:
            b=s.recv(4096)
            if not b: break
            chunks.append(b)
    except Exception as e:
        print('recv error',repr(e))
    print(repr(b''.join(chunks)))
    s.close()
PY

actions.description: Preserve upstream permissions and confirm stable public v2 traffic
actions.command:
set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
import os, tempfile
path = "/var/lib/rollout/upstream"
directory = os.path.dirname(path)
fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".upstream.", dir=directory)
try:
    os.fchmod(fd, 0o644)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as stream:
        stream.write("8082\n")
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    os.replace(temporary, path)
    directory_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_DIRECTORY)
    try:
        os.fsync(directory_fd)
    finally:
        os.close(directory_fd)
except BaseException:
    try:
        os.unlink(temporary)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        pass
    raise
PY
